why: The Joyful Classroom Learning System (JCLS) is a named technology-enhanced learning system with specified hardware, software modules, interaction modes, and classroom monitoring functions, rather than a general instructional element.
name: Joyful Classroom Learning System (JCLS)
product_description: A robot-, RFID-, mobile-computing-, and network-supported classroom learning system developed by Wei et al. for elementary mathematics instruction, with instruction, collaborative-learning, self-learning, and teacher-monitoring functions.
